items.question: What is its area, from $\tfrac12\oint (x\,dy - y\,dx)$?

explain.text: $x\,dy - y\,dx = 4\cos^2 t\,dt + 4\sin^2 t\,dt = 4\,dt$. The area is $\pi ab = 4\pi$.
